title: Shotgun metagenomics pipeline parameters
description: Parameter contract for the production Nextflow workflow.

input.description: CSV samplesheet with sample, fastq_1, and fastq_2 columns. Mutually exclusive with sraProject.

sraProject.description: NCBI BioProject accession used by the staged launcher (--sra-project). Direct auto-mode Nextflow execution intentionally redirects users to the launcher. Mutually exclusive with input.

sraManifest.description: Internal path to the frozen run-level SRA project manifest.

sraCheckpointManifest.description: Internal validated manifest of biological-sample non-host read checkpoints.

sraSampleId.description: Internal biological sample selected for one sequential preprocessing invocation.

sraCheckpointDir.description: Dedicated external persistent directory for validated paired non-host SRA checkpoints. It must be empty on first use and is sealed to one BioProject and frozen-manifest hash. Required in SRA mode.

sraScratchDir.description: Internal per-sample acquisition scratch path supplied by the staged launcher; the user-facing --sra-scratch-dir is its external parent root.

sraCacheDir.description: Internal prefetch cache root selected by the staged launcher.

sraTempDir.description: Internal fasterq-dump temporary root selected by the staged launcher.

sraStateDir.description: Persistent SRA manifests and lifecycle-state directory under pipeline_info.

sraMaxSize.description: Value passed to prefetch --max-size; u means unlimited after metadata validation.

sraContainer.description: Combined image containing SRA Toolkit 3.4.1, pigz 2.8, and Python 3.12.

sraEmail.description: Optional contact email sent with NCBI E-utilities requests.

sraContainerOptions.description: Internal bind options generated by the staged launcher for external SRA cache, scratch, temporary, and checkpoint roots.

sraRequireComplete.description: Internal checkpoint-reconciliation gate set true only before the global stage.

executionStage.description: Internal dispatcher stage. BioProject users should not set it manually; the launcher coordinates the safe sequence.

enableGpu.description: Internal compute-device flag. Direct Nextflow users must also select the gpu profile; the launcher --enable-gpu sets both.

gpuAccelerators.description: Exactly one accelerator is requested by each verified GPU-enabled process.

gpuContainerOptions.description: Internal runtime exposure option: Docker --gpus 1 or Apptainer/Singularity --nv.

slurmGpuGres.description: Explicit site-specific SLURM GRES value used only in the gpu profile.

gpuTelemetryInterval.description: Seconds between best-effort nvidia-smi samples inside GPU tasks.

telemetryDir.description: Internal per-invocation directory for native Nextflow trace, report, timeline, and DAG artifacts.

checkm2_db.description: CheckM2 database directory or DIAMOND database file.

phylophlan_container.description: Container image containing PhyloPhlAn 3.1.1 and IQ-TREE 3.0.1.
